prerequisites.value: member of a Hellknight order, trained in heavy armor as well as your order's favored weapon

special.value:
You can't select another dedication feat except dedication feats for higher positions within the Hellknights until you have gained two other feats from the Hellknight armiger archetype.
Leads to: Ardent Armiger|LOWG, Armiger's Mobility|LOWG, Diabolic Certitude|LOWG, Mortification|LOWG, Advanced Order Training|LOCG, Hellknight Dedication|LOCG, Blade of Law|LOCG, Hell's Armaments|LOCG, Hellknight Order Cross-training|LOCG, Sense Chaos|LOCG, Hellknight Signifer Dedication|LOCG, Gaze of Veracity|LOCG, Masked Casting|LOCG, Signifer Armor Expertise|LOCG, Signifer's Sight|LOCG, Order Training|LOCG

description.value:
Your Hellknight training teaches you to terrorize others into compliance, but you also study the structure and hierarchy of Hell. You must survive painful tests of your body and mind called reckonings, which steady your mind against all sorts of trauma.

You gain resistance to mental damage equal to 1 + your number of class feats from the Hellknight Armiger archetype and other Hellknight archetypes. You become trained in Intimidation and Hell Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead.
